paper_plane_scroll_engine.concept: A hand-drawn line-art paper plane travelling down an winding SVG dashed flight trail spanning the entire vertical height of the document, rotating dynamically along the curve using CSS offset-path or SVG tangent transform.
implementation_steps: 1. Calculate global scroll percentage using Framer Motion's useScroll() or Lenis scroll callback.
2. Render an overlay SVG container spanning position: absolute / fixed with top:0, left:0, width: 100%, height: 100%.
3. Define a smooth responsive Bézier curve path (e.g., M 100,50 C 300,400 50,800 250,1200 S 350,1800 100,2200...) that weaving through left and right margins of each section.
4. Bind motion.div (holding SVG Paper Plane icon) to offsetPath: path(...) and offsetDistance: scrollYProgress percentage.
5. Animate strokeDashoffset of the background dashed line matching scroll progress to create a growing flight trail behind the plane.
